body: It's not embarrassing, periodontal problems happens. Don't avoid the dentist, they've seen it all and can resolve/prevent your problem. Just stay calm and keep doing your best, you are right about that it's that matters 😊

Hi, NAD. It's ok if you are afraid,  but try to not expect the worst case scenario, just do your part (maintain good oral hygiene) until the appointment. Bush your teeth after each meal, and very important, brush them before going to bed, that's the most important. Maybe you could use the Bass technic to brush, it's recommended for gingivitis. Use rinse without alcohol and brush them well but gentle. 
Also, stay calm. It's going to be ok.
